## Check the distribution of p-value cutoffs

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
res_alpha %>%
  count(pcut) %>%
  arrange(pcut) %>%
  mutate(pcut = factor(pcut, levels = unique(pcut))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pcut, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightgreen", color = "seagreen4", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "p-value cutoff",
    y = "Count",
    title = "alpha chain"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```


```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
res_beta %>%
  count(pcut) %>%
  arrange(pcut) %>%
  mutate(pcut = factor(pcut, levels = unique(pcut))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pcut, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightgreen", color = "seagreen4", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "p-value cutoff",
    y = "Count",
    title = "beta chain"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

df <- res_both %>%
  filter(is.finite(pcut_A), is.finite(pcut_B), pcut_A > 0, pcut_B > 0)

# count each unique (pcut_A, pcut_B) combo and order axes by numeric p-values
tab <- df %>%
  count(pcut_A, pcut_B, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    x = factor(pcut_A, levels = sort(unique(pcut_A))),  # ordered smallest→largest
    y = factor(pcut_B, levels = sort(unique(pcut_B)))
  )

# marginal totals for bars
colsum <- tab %>% group_by(x) %>% summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
rowsum <- tab %>% group_by(y) %>% summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# pretty labels for discrete (factor) axes
lab_p <- function(v) scales::label_scientific()(as.numeric(as.character(v)))


# lock factor levels from the heatmap data
levels_x <- levels(tab$x)
levels_y <- levels(tab$y)

# HEATMAP (raw p-values)
p_heat <- ggplot(tab, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Count") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = levels_x, drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = levels_y, drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "pcut_A", y = "pcut_B", title = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

# TOP BAR (column totals) — lock x levels, no expansion
colsum <- colsum %>% mutate(x = factor(x, levels = levels_x))
p_top <- ggplot(colsum, aes(x = x, y = total)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = levels_x, drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = "Total") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

# RIGHT BAR (row totals) — lock y levels, no expansion; aligns to heatmap only
rowsum <- rowsum %>% mutate(y = factor(y, levels = levels_y))
p_right <- ggplot(rowsum, aes(y = y, x = total)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = levels_y, drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Total") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

# ---- assemble with a spacer in the top-right cell ----
design <- "
AB
CD
"

p_top + plot_spacer() + p_heat + p_right +
  plot_layout(design = design, widths = c(4, 1.3), heights = c(1.2, 4))



```

## Check the consistency of p-value threshold. 

Some mutations are predicted in multiple cancer types. We can check the consistency of p-value threshold. 

## Read in all the somatic mutation data

```{r}
mut_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA"
mutation_file = "mc3.v0.2.8.CONTROLLED.maf.gz"

mut_dat0 = fread(file.path(mut_dir, mutation_file), 
                select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "NCBI_Build", "Chromosome", "Strand", 
                           "Start_Position", "End_Position", "Reference_Allele", 
                           "Tumor_Seq_Allele1", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", 
                           "Variant_Classification", "Variant_Type", 
                           "Feature", "Feature_type", "Consequence", 
                           "HGVSc", "HGVSp", "HGVSp_Short"))
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

mut_dat0 = distinct(mut_dat0)
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

table(mut_dat0$Strand)
table(mut_dat0$Variant_Type)
```

# Write output of optimal p-value threshold

```{r fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}
mut_symbol = paste(mut_dat0$Hugo_Symbol, mut_dat0$Chromosome, 
                   mut_dat0$Start_Position, mut_dat0$Reference_Allele, 
                   mut_dat0$Tumor_Seq_Allele2, sep=":")

str1 = "LZTR1:22:21343966:GAGGAGGTGAGGGGCGTGGGGAGCCAGGGCGCAGGTA:-"
str2 = "LZTR1:22:21343966:G*A:-"
mut_symbol = gsub(str1, str2, mut_symbol, fixed = TRUE)

mut_dat0[, mut := mut_symbol]

mut_all = union(union(df_alpha$mut, df_beta$mut), df_both$mut)
stopifnot(all(mut_all %in% mut_symbol))

mut_dat0 = mut_dat0[mut_dat0$mut %in% mut_all,]
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

df_all = list("alpha" = df_alpha, "beta" = df_beta, "both" = df_both)

length(t_alpha)
t_alpha[t_alpha > 2]

length(t_beta)
t_beta[t_beta > 2]

length(t_both)
t_both[t_both > 2]

for(key1 in names(df_all)){
  cat(key1, ": ")
  cat(date(), "\n")
  
  df1 = data.table(df_all[[key1]])
  df1 = merge(df1, mut_dat0, all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
  df1_uniq_mut = df1 %>% group_by(mut) %>% 
    filter(auc == max(auc)) %>% ungroup() %>% data.frame()
  
  df1 = df1[order(df1$auc, decreasing = TRUE),]
  df1_uniq_mut = df1_uniq_mut[order(df1_uniq_mut$auc, decreasing = TRUE),]
  
  fnm = sprintf("cv_optimal_pcut_%s_mut_cancer_combos.tsv", key1)
  fwrite(df1, file.path(res_dir, fnm), sep="\t")

  fnm = sprintf("cv_optimal_pcut_%s_uniq_mutations.tsv", key1)
  fwrite(df1_uniq_mut, file.path(res_dir, fnm), sep="\t")
  
  rm(df1)
  rm(df1_uniq_mut)
  gc()
}

```

## Read in TCR-mutation assocaition data

```{r fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}

draw_roc <- function(mut_name, pcut_A, pcut_B, c_type, pname){
  r1_a = fread(file.path(res_dir, sprintf("train_alpha_wo_%s.tsv", c_type)))
  r1_b = fread(file.path(res_dir, sprintf("train_beta_wo_%s.tsv", c_type)))
  r1_a$TCR = paste0("alpha_", r1_a$TCR)
  r1_b$TCR = paste0("beta_",  r1_b$TCR)
  r1_a$chain = "A"
  r1_b$chain = "B"
  
  r1 = rbind(r1_a, r1_b)
    
  d1_a = get_dat_one_cancer(c_type, TCR_data_a, mut_data, sample_info)
  mut1_a = d1_a$mut_mat
  tcr1_a = d1_a$TCR_mat
  
  d1_b = get_dat_one_cancer(c_type, TCR_data_b, mut_data, sample_info)
  mut1_b = d1_b$mut_mat
  tcr1_b = d1_b$TCR_mat
  
  mut1 = mut1_a
  
  stopifnot(identical(mut1_a, mut1_b))
  stopifnot(all(colnames(tcr1_a) == colnames(tcr1_b)))
  stopifnot(all(colnames(mut1) == colnames(tcr1_b)))
  
  rownames(tcr1_a) = paste0("alpha_", rownames(tcr1_a))
  rownames(tcr1_b) = paste0("beta_",  rownames(tcr1_b))
  tcr1 = rbind(tcr1_a, tcr1_b)
  
  dim(tcr1)
  tcr1[1:2,1:4]
  
  dim(mut1)
  mut1[1:2,1:4]
  
  mut_j = mut1[rownames(mut1) == mut_name,]
  res_j = r1[which(r1$mut == mut_name),,drop = FALSE]
  
  tcr_ji = res_j[(pval_LRT < pcut_A & chain == "A") | (pval_LRT < pcut_B & chain == "B"), "TCR"]
  tcr_ji = unlist(tcr_ji)
  ww_tcr = which(rownames(tcr1) %in% tcr_ji)
  length(ww_tcr)
  
  tcr_pred_ji = colSums(tcr1[ww_tcr,,drop=FALSE] > 0)
  table(tcr_pred_ji)
  table(mut_j)
  
  table(tcr_pred_ji, mut_j)
  
  roc_obj <- roc(response = mut_j, predictor = tcr_pred_ji, quiet = TRUE)
  auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  roc_df  <- data.frame(
    FPR = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    threshold = roc_obj$thresholds
  )
  
  # --- ggplot ROC ---
  gg1 = ggplot(roc_df, aes(FPR, TPR)) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_equal() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
    labs(
      subtitle = sprintf("%s@%s", pname, c_type), 
      x = "1 - Specificity",
      y = "Sensitivity"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
    annotate("text",
           x = 0.98, y = 0.02,  
           label = sprintf("AUC = %.3f", auc_val),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5) 

  gg1
}

cols = c("mut", "cancer", "auc", "pcut_A", "pcut_B", "Freq", "HGVSp_Short")

df_both[auc > 0.7, ..cols]
df_both[Freq > 100, ..cols]

draw_roc(mut_name = "TP53:17:7577539:G:A", pcut_A = 0.05, pcut_B = 0.1, 
         c_type = "STAD", pname = "TP53.p.R248W")

draw_roc(mut_name = "TP53:17:7578403:C:A", pcut_A = 0.05, pcut_B = 0.1, 
         c_type = "BRCA", pname = "TP53.p.C176F")

draw_roc(mut_name = "TP53:17:7578442:T:C", pcut_A = 0.05, pcut_B = 0.1, 
         c_type = "BRCA", pname = "TP53.p.Y163C")

draw_roc(mut_name = "TP53:17:7577538:C:T", pcut_A = 0.1, pcut_B = 0.2, 
         c_type = "LUSC", pname = "TP53.p.R248Q")

draw_roc(mut_name = "KRAS:12:25398284:C:A", pcut_A = 0.01, pcut_B = 0.1, 
         c_type = "STAD", pname = "KRAS.p.G12V")
```

## Check AUC

```{r fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4}

library(ggsci)

cancers <- levels(factor(df_both$cancer))

pal <- ggsci::pal_igv("default")(length(cancers))
names(pal) <- cancers

pal["ESCA"] <- "#FF8C00"   # <- pick any hex you prefer


p_auc <- ggplot(df_both, aes(x = Freq, y = auc, color = cancer)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Mutation Freq.", y = "AUC", color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, breaks = cancers) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + guides(
  colour = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 4.5, alpha = 1, shape = 16, stroke = 0) 
  )
)

df_both$to_label <- with(df_both, (auc > 0.7) | (Freq > 100))

p_auc_labeled <- p_auc +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(df_both, to_label),
    aes(label = paste0(Hugo_Symbol, HGVSp_Short)),
    size = 3.5, 
    force = 3.5, 
    max.overlaps = Inf, 
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.alpha = 0.8, 
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) 

p_auc_labeled 
```
